test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All horses are donkeys.

All donkeys are mules.

Conclusions:

(i) All donkeys are horses.

(ii) Some mules are donkeys.

options.text: Both conclusion I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
Statements: All horse

s are donkeys;

Conclusion:

Conclusion (i): All donkeys are horses. → **false** (because the statements only say all horses are donkeys.)

Conclusion (ii): Some mules are donkeys. → **true** (because if all donkeys are mules, then at least some mules must be donkeys.)

Thus, only conclusion (ii) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
